items.player: Alvin Kamara / Travis Etienne / Kendre Miller
items.claim: Saints signed Etienne to 4-year/$48M ($28M guaranteed) on first day of free agency; Week 1 even split with Miller; Week 2 Miller healthy scratch and Kamara (31) received 15 opportunities vs Etienne 11. Kamara one of worst RBs by metrics last year and 1.7 YPC / 1.4 YPR in Week 2.
items.dfsImpact: Backfield role uncertainty and potential inefficiency for NO RBs; monitor for continued Kamara volume vs Etienne efficiency and any Miller reactivation. Relevant for classic DFS salary/value and GPP leverage decisions.
items.recommendedFollowup: Track Week 3 practice reports and any coach comments on NO backfield hierarchy; reassess opportunity share after next game.

items.claim: Panthers never trailed, dominated, won 34-3 yet Bryce Young still dropped back 39 times vs 17 called runs. Under new playcaller Brad Idzik, Panthers 4th in Pass Rate Over Expectation (only DAL, BUF, SF higher).
items.dfsImpact: Elevated pass volume/PROE supports higher team pass attempts and upside for CAR pass catchers/QB even in positive game scripts. Useful for stacking and game-environment modeling.
items.recommendedFollowup: Monitor whether elevated PROE persists in Week 3 and against different opponent scripts.

items.claim: With Puka Nacua (hip) out, Terrance Ferguson ran the 2nd-most routes on the team. On 33 Matthew Stafford dropbacks: Adams 27, Ferguson 23, Mumpfield 21, Smith 19, Atwell 10, Parkinson 10, Allen 5, Higbee 4.
items.dfsImpact: Route share insight for LAR WR depth if Nacua limited or out Week 3; Ferguson and Mumpfield saw elevated opportunity. Relevant for late-swap and ownership if Nacua status changes.
items.recommendedFollowup: Monitor Nacua practice participation and official injury report; track route participation if he sits or is limited.
